terms: These rules apply to access to Alex Orr's current personal All Seeing Eye installation. Access requires the operator's permission. Use it only for lawful, proportionate research and respect other people's privacy, intellectual property and source-specific conditions. Do not use it for stalking, harassment, doxxing, unauthorised surveillance, credential theft or discriminatory decisions. Do not upload material you lack authority to use or send to the selected providers. Do not submit sensitive personal information without a separately assessed lawful condition and safeguards. AI outputs and source labels are research aids and can be wrong; check the evidence before relying on or sharing them. The installation must not be used to make solely automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects on people. Report misuse or access concerns to alexorr@yahoo.co.uk. The operator may restrict access to investigate misuse or protect the service, while handling personal-data requests through the published procedure. These access rules do not grant a software redistribution licence, a third-party data licence, paid support or an availability guarantee. Any future commercial service requires its own agreed terms. Nothing here removes rights that cannot lawfully be excluded.
